events.title: Short scenario headline
events.summary: AI-driven compute growth is creating concentrated transformer demand in data-center regions. Manufacturing lead times may not match near-term replacement needs, raising operational and procurement pressure.

events.title: Inverter-scale shift pressures critical-mineral flows
events.summary: Shift to grid-forming inverters and modular BESS increases short-term demand for copper and lithium inputs. Concentrated procurement could stress upstream material supply chains and delay deployments.

events.title: Policy nudges toward standard modular procurement
events.summary: Standardized procurement specifications may reduce bespoke engineering delays and speed modular equipment adoption, yet risk interoperability and integration costs with legacy systems.

events.title: Upstream concentration raises delivery risk for lithium precursors
events.summary: Concentrated precursor refining creates a chokepoint risk for battery cell supply. Projects relying on tight schedules are vulnerable to upstream processing or logistics disruptions.

events.title: HVDC corridor interest as a response to remote renewable zones
events.summary: HVDC corridors offer efficient long-distance transfer but require specialized large transformers and converters with limited manufacturing capacity, risking concentrated bottlenecks.

events.title: EPC schedules tighten amid modular product demand
events.summary: Modular hardware shortens equipment lead times but shifts constraints to skilled integration labor and commissioning schedules, creating new project-risk vectors.

events.title: Microgrid and hybrid solutions entering data-center planning
events.summary: Data centers are evaluating microgrid/hybrid architectures to hedge grid upgrade lead-time risk. Such systems reduce immediate transformer dependency but create operational and regulatory trade-offs.

events.title: Interop frictions emerging between modular OEMs and legacy control systems
events.summary: Integration challenges between modular equipment and older relays are increasing commissioning effort and may reduce anticipated time-to-service gains from modular procurement.

events.title: Attack-surface increases with distributed inverter deployments
events.summary: Distributed inverter deployments are expanding the operational cyber attack surface. Heterogeneous device management practices increase need for coordinated security controls.

events.title: Ancillary services market signals shift with inverter participation
events.summary: Inverter participation in ancillary services is reshaping short-duration market signals and could redirect investment toward fast-responding assets.
